coordinateBasis.comparison: Require exact CGPoint origin equality. Compare four absolute edges in order minX,minY,maxX,maxY after multiplying each edge by the actual window.screen.scale and applying Swift rounded() to the physical-pixel lattice. Compare those keys exactly, with no epsilon.

coordinateBasis.reason: SwiftUI anchor resolution and UIKit coordinate conversion can reconstruct the same transformed rectangle through different floating-point addition/subtraction paths. Full CGRect bit equality conflates that arithmetic with a real projection mismatch. Exact origins, exact owned local dimensions and exact physical edge placement retain separate, explicit responsibilities.
